scripts.dev: pnpm dev:clean && concurrently -k -n nia,sample "pnpm dev:nia" "pnpm dev:sample"
scripts.dev:clean: pkill -x Nia 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'Nia Helper' 2>/dev/null || true; for port in 1420 1421; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; rm -rf "$HOME/Library/Caches/dev.nia.app/cef"
scripts.check:rust: cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked
